scope:
Measure ES1 asset reuse in the effective ES2 Win95 v1.1 resource set.

Whole-file identities, preserved PCM samples and indexed-image remaps are
separate observations. Neither file counts nor modern source-file similarity
measure the percentage of original engine source code reused.
reference: cd_v1_1_1997_09 effective simulator and shell resources, deduplicated by resource name and SHA-256
exclusions: Loose executables, AVI/DFL movies and CD tracks are excluded from asset-count denominators. ES2 demos on ES1 media are excluded. Hash equality alone does not establish that an asset is used at runtime. Indexed remaps do not assert identical RGB palettes.
sample_indexing: Zero-based: odd_sample_positions means PCM bytes at indices 1, 3, 5, and so on.
